avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces binimetinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases binimetinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; maintain consistent grapefruit avoidance

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 induction may modestly reduce binimetinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; use with clinical judgment

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive effects on platelet function; binimetinib can cause bleeding
caution_supplements.action: Use at standard doses; counsel on bleeding precautions

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases binimetinib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; educate on all grapefruit-containing products

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase binimetinib absorption; variable bioavailability documented
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary patterns

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Minor CYP3A4 induction potential with high chronic intake
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; maintain normal vegetable consumption

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of toxicity (diarrhea, rash, cardiac effects) as binimetinib has a narrow therapeutic window. Assess medication adherence and CYP3A4 inhibitor/inducer exposure at each visit, particularly with any new supplements or dietary changes.
